text:
According to the Hermes Agent documentation, you should not edit core files directly to add custom tools. Instead, custom tools are intended to be built as external plugins:

1. Place your custom tool/plugin in the **`~/.hermes/plugins/`** directory.
2. Enable it by running the command:
   ```bash
   hermes plugins enable <plugin_name>
   ```

You can also run `hermes tools` to check and manage active toolsets.
